overall_pass_rule: DB derives passed=true iff every canonical check is PASS or a policy-permitted NOT_APPLICABLE; FAIL and WARN always prevent PASS. Caller hard_gate is not authoritative and V1 requires hard_gate=true for every canonical check.
failure_evidence_rule: FAIL or WARN requires non-null reason_code and non-empty detail; PASS may omit both. NOT_APPLICABLE must satisfy the exact applicability predicate.

caption_safe_bounds.not_applicable_condition: Allowed only when edit_plan.captions.enabled=false and disclosure_render.overlay_events is empty.

caption_overlap.not_applicable_condition: Allowed only when edit_plan.captions.enabled=false and disclosure_render.overlay_events is empty.

uniqueness.not_applicable_condition: Allowed only when the sealed uniqueness_rules contains no NO_REUSED_EDIT, UNIQUE_PER_ACCOUNT or UNIQUE_PER_CAMPAIGN clause.

disclosure_video.not_applicable_condition: Allowed only when disclosure_requirements is NOT_APPLICABLE or does not require VIDEO/BOTH.

render_audio_compliance.not_applicable_condition: Allowed only when clip.audio_plan_id is null AND sealed render_audio_rules.knowledge_state=NOT_APPLICABLE. The manifest must still be internally truthful: null audio identity, empty render_safe_assets, clip rule snapshot match, planned_music_asset_id=null and planned_sfx_asset_ids=[]. A KNOWN render-audio rule requires PASS even for deliberate silent/no-extra-audio; UNKNOWN blocks.
render_audio_compliance.ready_forbidden_when: FAIL/WARN, illegal NOT_APPLICABLE, any embedded render-safe asset without exact committed audio plan, any baked asset failing current HONOR_AUDIO_ASSET_RIGHTS_CONTRACT.json eligibility, manifest UUID/kind/SHA/license mismatch, UNKNOWN render_audio_rules, or unresolved/material render-audio instruction.
render_audio_compliance.round11_manifest_evidence: For non-null plans, QC/manifest admission verifies each baked asset exactly matches immutable audio_assets id/kind/sha256/license_url_or_reference, committed-plan membership and current eligibility.

null_audio_plan_contract.manifest: audio_plan_id/hash/version/schema_version must be null and render_safe_assets must be empty
null_audio_plan_contract.qc_not_applicable: Only legal when sealed render_audio_rules knowledge_state is NOT_APPLICABLE. KNOWN requires PASS; UNKNOWN blocks; actual embedded MUSIC/SFX is always forbidden without an exact audio plan.
null_audio_plan_contract.operational_instruction: A KNOWN material render-audio instruction requires explicit PASS evidence even for a silent/no-extra-audio render; it is not automatically N/A.
